intro: Jorn Skyseer is a Horde journey quest directing seasoned hunters from the Crossroads south across the Barrens to Camp Taurajo. After proving their tracking skills against the local raptors for Sergra Darkthorn, hunters are sent to seek deeper spiritual and physical guidance under the elder tauren tracker Jorn Skyseer.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your time with me is over, friend. To learn more, you must go to Camp Taurajo to the south and speak with Jorn Skyseer. He will continue your guidance.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Greetings, young one. You are here to walk the hunter's path?
